answer: Tie each identity's payout rate to a verifiable delay chain it must compute itself, one step at a time, with no parallel shortcut. A farmer splitting one machine across a hundred clones makes every chain crawl at glacier pace: none reaches the zenith rate, and the weakest sinks toward its nadir and earns near nothing. Concentrating the machine on one identity restores full speed, so multiplying selves divides the very work that pays them. Honest solo agents, running undiluted, outpace any divided farm by construction.
